description: Edit an existing Bear note. Provide 'append_text' to add text, 'body' to replace content, or 'set_frontmatter'/'remove_frontmatter' to edit YAML front matter fields. Front matter edits can be combined with each other but not with body/append.

after.description: Insert appended text after the line containing this text (use with append_text)

append_text.description: Text to append to the end of the note

body.description: New content to replace the entire note body

remove_frontmatter.description: Front matter field keys to remove

replace_section.description: Replace content under this heading (replaces until next heading of same or higher level)

section_content.description: New content for the section (use with replace_section)

set_frontmatter.description: Front matter fields to set or update (key-value pairs)

name: bear_edit_note
